mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_minute_price (stock_id, trade_date, bar_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, source) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, #{barTime}, #{openPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{closePrice}, #{volume}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), source = VALUES(source)
mapper.select: SELECT stock_id, trade_date, bar_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, source FROM stock_minute_price WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY bar_time ASC
